text_block_list.text:
One day, while watching Нарита Брайан's
dance
practice...

Phew... Well, guess this is it. Although
this is just
an added bonus to watching
the race, I can't be
too lax about it.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: Whoa! You're a good dancer, Brian!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
...Oh, Mayano. I'm in the middle of a
lesson, so
don't bother me.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: Roger that! Sorry!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
Oh... but I may have found your
weakness. ♪
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text: What weakness?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: Well, I don't think you smile enough. ♪
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
...But I am smiling, just as
choreographed. I'm
smiling right when
I'm supposed to.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: Well, your normal face is already a bit scary, so I think you've gotta smile even more. ♪
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
You sure don't mince words... But I
disagree. It's
not necessary.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
What?! It totally is! You agree, don't
you,
Тренер?
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text: Hey, don't entertain her nonsense!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан
choice_data_list: Let's at least give it a try!

text_block_list.text: Hey, don't entertain her nonsense!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан
choice_data_list: Let's at least give it a try!

text_block_list.text: Tch! Why, you...
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
Haha, I knew it! ♪ All right, then, I'll join
you for
smiling practice! ♪
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text: I never said I was going to do it.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан
choice_data_list: Do it for a better performance!

text_block_list.text: Fine. All I have to do is smile, right?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: See? It's not like it's hard!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
Hmm. How should I put this... Your
dance moves
are sharp, but...
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган
choice_data_list: Your expression is also quite sharp.

text_block_list.text:
What?! It's not like I'm angry or
anything. I swear
I'm smiling!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: Don't get angry. Just give us a smile! ♪
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text: I told you I'm not angry!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: You sure look angry!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
Hmmm. Looks like I have no choice but
to take
charge of this lesson!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text: No, wait... Ugh, give me a break...
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: Eh?! Why?!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган
choice_data_list: Brian's cool smile is her selling point.

text_block_list.text:
Hey, I'm not trying to sell anything, you
know...
But, fine, let's just go with that.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
Hmm, I don't get it. What do you mean?
Smiling
doesn't matter?
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
Heh, it means there's more than one way
to smile.
You'll understand when you
grow up.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
Huh?! You mean if I understand it, I'll be
a
grown-up?!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
Wh-what's with the dreamy eyes all of a
sudden?!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
I got it! I'm gonna take this chance to
study your
coolness!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text: Don't worry! I won't bother you!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
If you don't bother me, then fine... Suit
yourself.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
Whoa! So that's a "cool" way to answer,
right?! I'm
already learning so much! ♪
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
Uh, sure... This isn't going to be easy, is
it...
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
Under the fervent guidance of Mayano
Top Gun,
Нарита Брайан takes a crash
course in smiling and
seems to glean
something from it.

Surprisingly, Brian does her lesson with
more
vigor than usual because of the
extra eyes on her.
